messages.subject: Project Willow - strategy ahead of AAA mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
James, Elena,

Marlow's IBR supports a return to 3.5x by FY27 on the base case, which gives us a good platform. For the AAA I want us to anchor on: margin 5.25% (Bank will push for more), opening leverage covenant 4.75x stepping to 3.50x, DSCR 1.10x rising to 1.20x, and three equity cures. The £4m new equity and £2m TLA prepayment are the headline concessions - use them.

Elena, please prepare the first draft of the amendment and restatement from our precedent. James to lead the call with Pendle Voss.

Thanks

Sarah Whitfield
Partner, Restructuring & Finance
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
